tasks.short: Coordinate set design with lighting and sound

steps.what: Consult the current set design and the available lighting and sound layouts
inputs: lighting and sound layouts supplied by their designers

steps.what: Collaborate with lighting and sound leads to coordinate those production aspects with set designs or exhibit layouts
outputs: coordinated design choices and unresolved conflicts

tasks.design: Configure a current-version reference view in {DOCS} so the designer can open the existing set, lighting and sound layouts together. Keep coordination and conflict resolution with the production leads; no meeting report or automatic design change is introduced.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding the right layout versions can interrupt coordination.
tasks.enabler_now: Native version views and saved references reduce navigation.
tasks.still_hard: Resolve incompatible creative and physical requirements.
tasks.human_edge: Negotiate practical choices across production disciplines.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: document version views can reduce reference navigation without resolving production design conflicts.

assumptions: Boundary covers reference consultation and collaboration, not subsequent plan editing. No separate minutes or send is established.
Set, lighting and sound designers supply their existing layouts with production ID and version. If no shared version reference exists, manual source confirmation remains in s1.
Test native references first. Shares are unmeasured scenarios. Gross 1 minus 0.2 upkeep leaves 0.8 net; no saving if layouts are already immediately available.
research_questions: Does a native current-version view remove any reference navigation in real coordination sessions?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Zero when references are already available; up to 0.5% for smaller navigation improvement than central 0.8% net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Select props that suit the set

steps.what: Browse existing prop inventory and hire catalogue entries for furniture, pictures, lamps and rugs
inputs: existing prop inventory and hire catalogue

steps.what: Examine candidate props and select furniture, pictures, lamps and rugs suitable for the design and actual stage use

tasks.design: Use native category, size and period filters in the prop inventory or hire catalogue {OTHER}. The designer examines and chooses the actual props; catalogue filtering does not reserve or order them.
tasks.previous_blocker: Broad catalogues make finding plausible candidates slow.
tasks.still_hard: A catalogue image does not establish condition or suitability under stage lighting.
tasks.human_edge: Judge appearance and practical use in the production.

ambition.what: No additional hire or purchasing authority granted.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: prop catalogue filters can narrow candidates while actual suitability remains a designer judgement.

assumptions: OTHER is the prop inventory and hire catalogue. Boundary is candidate browsing and selection; reservations, purchase orders and dispatches are not performed.
Inventory owners and hire suppliers already provide item ID, category, dimensions and available images. Missing metadata means manual browsing, not unpaid new tagging.
Native facets first. No new selection record is invented. Shares and reduction are provisional; gross 6 minus 0.5 upkeep yields 5.5 net.
unknowns: Catalogue metadata completeness and actual browsing effort
research_questions: Do existing filters narrow candidates without excluding suitable untagged props?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Zero for poor catalogue coverage; up to 3% when filtering gains are smaller than central 5.5% net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Design and build a scale set model

steps.what: Design scaled dimensions and component drawings for the set model or miniature filming set in the drawing editor
inputs: chosen model scale and intended use

steps.what: Check component dimensions and model proportions and select the final scaled drawings
inputs: chosen model scale and intended use

steps.what: Save the checked scaled drawings in the same drawing editor
Cut, assemble, finish and physically check the scale model or miniature set used for backgrounds or special effects
outputs: built and physically checked scale model or miniature set

tasks.design: Configure native scale conversion and reusable geometry in the drawing editor {OTHER}. The designer checks and saves the completed component drawings, then builds and physically checks the model; no saving is assigned to cutting, assembly or finishing.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated scale and component edits add drawing effort before construction.
tasks.enabler_now: Native drawing tools can apply chosen scales and reuse geometry.
tasks.still_hard: A correctly scaled drawing may not create the required physical or filmed effect.
tasks.human_edge: Make and assess a tangible model for its intended production use.

ambition.what: No additional miniature effects service claimed.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: drawing tools can assist scale conversion; physical model construction still requires craft work.

assumptions: OTHER is the drawing editor. Boundary includes digital model design and actual physical construction; no purchase or tool-machine action is introduced.
Designer supplies actual set dimensions, chosen scale and intended filming or presentation purpose in s1. Missing dimensions are manually resolved there; software does not infer them.
Test native scaling first. Shares are provisional, not a measured drawing baseline. A hand-built model without digital drawings receives no claimed benefit.
The final dimension check is actual design verification, not an added approval process. Same-editor save is 1% fully retained. Gross 3.75 minus 0.5 upkeep gives 3.25 net.
unknowns: Whether models currently use digital drawings
Actual share of repeat scale work
research_questions: Does native scaling reduce component drawing effort while preserving fit during actual assembly?

already_counted.description: Review scaled component drawings and verify dimensions

incremental.description: Maintain reusable model components and scale settings

approvals.approved_version: checked final scaled drawings from s2; dimension edits void check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Zero for wholly manual model design or already configured scaling; up to 2% with smaller drawing gains than central 3.25% net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Examine exhibit objects to choose their display

steps.what: Examine the actual objects to be included in exhibits and judge where and how to display them
inputs: available exhibit space and intended interpretation
outputs: object-specific display choices and unresolved constraints

tasks.design: Keep direct object examination and display judgement with the designer. An inventory view in {OTHER} can describe objects but cannot establish their actual condition, visual presence or suitable display from records alone.
tasks.previous_blocker: Display choices depend on the physical objects and context.
tasks.enabler_now: Inventory records provide context, without replacing object examination.
tasks.still_hard: Balance interpretation, visibility and physical constraints.
tasks.human_edge: Notice an object characteristic that changes how it should be shown.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: object display choices require examination of the actual object and space.

assumptions: OTHER denotes an exhibit inventory if consulted. Boundary is examination and display judgement. The statement establishes no separate catalogue update, condition report, layout drawing or send; none is assigned invented time.
Inputs are actual objects and space; no structured capture is required by this unchanged design. Native inventory views cannot remove physical examination.
No new tool means no incremental upkeep. The whole task remains retained; the share is not a measured duration.
unknowns: Whether an object examination locally produces a separate condition or layout record
research_questions: Observe object examination and separate any actual written condition or placement record.

incremental.description: No introduced tool or record process

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Physical examination and display judgement are fully retained; no distinct record-writing workload is established.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The designer retains creative choices, object examination and physical model construction; native tools assist reference navigation and repeated drawing work.
skills_to_grow: Use native scale and geometry settings
Check catalogue completeness before relying on filters
role.ambitious_version: Better-supported practical design while preserving firsthand production judgement.
